question: Who is qualified to perform the rite associated with the fire-churning and hundred-thousand-worship names?
premises: A rite is associated with two named practices
The names involve fire-churning and hundred-thousand worship
The agent is described as the best among knowers
inference: The best among knowers should perform the rite of those two named practices
uncertainties: The exact identification of the two named practices is uncertain from this verse alone
plain_english: The best among knowers should perform the rite of the practices named fire-churning and hundred-thousand worship.
